rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal live-demo instruction anywhere in the body; this is a module file (metadata/LO/links/closer prose), not a demo lecture.

Every chunk carries a self-standing claim or list even in isolation: chunk 1 (Big Idea, one sentence, self-contained), chunk 10 (Optional challenges, four self-contained bullets), chunk 13 (Next, two self-contained sentences). No chunk is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet.

Closest candidate: chunk 6 'Set up the worktree' (lines 38-52) also carries the dense-slides blockquote and links to two closing lectures (packaging/gate) unrelated to worktree mechanics — the header does not preview that content, but it does not CONTRADICT it either (no claim in the header is falsified by the extra links); this reads as slide-size breadth, not a header/content mismatch, so it stays PASS rather than a rule-6 REVISE. All other headers (Big Idea, Prework, What You'll Learn, Start here, Your mid-run worries hint at missing checks, Key Concepts, Inspect your results, Back to the map one last time, Optional challenges, Bring to Module 6, Pre-reads before Module 6, Next) are true summaries of their own chunk content.

Grepped the full body for each sub-item's shape: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction anywhere; no anaphora/epistrophe triple (no repeated sentence-opener run); no self-grading superlative ('one of the most useful...' etc. — none found); no number-with-own-retraction pattern (numbers present — 'three lenses', 'three shapes', 'four sittings' — are all stated plainly, never hedged then walked back); no abstraction-noun-stack coinages; no verb triplet with an empty leg. All five sub-items clear across all chunks.
